Question 1
?

Determine the domain of the vector field F on R2, given by

F(x,y)=yx2+y2i+xx2−y2j.

a
{(x,y)∈R2|y≠±x}
b
{(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2≥1}
c
{(x,y)∈R2|(x,y)≠0}
d
{(x,y)∈R2|y≠x}
e
{(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2<1}
Submit
